import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()
    
    # Initialize rejection reason column
    orders["rejection_reason"] = None
    
    # R1: customer_id not present in ref_customers
    valid_customer_ids = set(ref_customers["customer_id"].dropna().unique())
    r1_fail = orders["rejection_reason"].isna() & ~orders["customer_id"].isin(valid_customer_ids)
    orders.loc[r1_fail, "rejection_reason"] = "CUST_UNKNOWN"
    
    # R2: customer status <> 'ACTIVE'
    cust_status = ref_customers.set_index("customer_id")["status"].to_dict()
    orders["_cust_status"] = orders["customer_id"].map(cust_status)
    r2_fail = orders["rejection_reason"].isna() & (orders["_cust_status"] != "ACTIVE")
    orders.loc[r2_fail, "rejection_reason"] = "CUST_INACTIVE"
    
    # R3: sku not present in ref_skus
    valid_skus = set(ref_skus["sku"].dropna().unique())
    r3_fail = orders["rejection_reason"].isna() & ~orders["sku"].isin(valid_skus)
    orders.loc[r3_fail, "rejection_reason"] = "SKU_UNKNOWN"
    
    # R4: sku discontinued = 1
    sku_disc = ref_skus.set_index("sku")["discontinued"].to_dict()
    orders["_discontinued"] = orders["sku"].map(sku_disc)
    r4_fail = orders["rejection_reason"].isna() & (orders["_discontinued"] == 1)
    orders.loc[r4_fail, "rejection_reason"] = "SKU_DISC"
    
    # R5: allowed_countries non-empty AND ship_country not in list
    allowed_countries_map = ref_skus.set_index("sku")["allowed_countries"].to_dict()
    orders["_allowed_countries"] = orders["sku"].map(allowed_countries_map)
    
    # For each row still without rejection, check country restriction
    for idx in orders.index:
        if orders.loc[idx, "rejection_reason"] is not None:
            continue
        
        allowed_str = orders.loc[idx, "_allowed_countries"]
        ship_country = orders.loc[idx, "ship_country"]
        
        # Empty or NULL means all countries allowed
        if pd.isna(allowed_str) or allowed_str == "":
            continue
        
        # Parse comma-delimited list with trimming
        allowed_list = [c.strip() for c in str(allowed_str).split(",")]
        
        if ship_country not in allowed_list:
            orders.loc[idx, "rejection_reason"] = "CTRY_BLOCKED"
    
    # Split into clean and rejects
    orders_clean = orders[orders["rejection_reason"].isna()].copy()
    orders_rejects = orders[orders["rejection_reason"].notna()].copy()
    
    # Keep only original columns for clean
    original_cols = ["order_id", "customer_id", "sku", "qty", "ship_country"]
    orders_clean = orders_clean[original_cols]
    
    # Keep original columns + reason_code for rejects
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects[original_cols + ["rejection_reason"]].copy()
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects.rename(columns={"rejection_reason": "reason_code"})
    
    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects.reset_index(drop=True)
    }
